feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Abdul El-Sayed welcomes Trump's plan to cut Israel aid, calls for end to arms sales
entry.summary: Michigan's first Muslim senator-elect, Abdul El-Sayed, discusses his historic victory, an unlikely agreement with Trump on Israel military aid and the political divisions that remain.

entry.title: The world is reacting to the Democrats' sweeping midterm elections victory
entry.summary: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win as foreign powers weigh how a flipped Congress will affect international relations.

entry.title: Democrats seize full control of Congress. And, which candidates made history last night
entry.summary: Democrats have won the House and the Senate, taking full control of Congress for the first time since 2023. And history was made in several states. Here's what happened last night.

entry.title: 6 takeaways from Democrats' big wave on election night
entry.summary: The magnitude of the Democrats' outcome was always a possibility, but the depth and breadth of their victories were jaw-dropping.

entry.title: Votes are still being counted to see who will represent Mississippi in the Senate
entry.summary: Votes are still being counted to determine who will represent Mississippi in the U.S. Senate. Democrat Scott Colom was only a handful of votes ahead of Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith early Wednesday.

entry.title: Review: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is superb, streamlined and safe
entry.summary: Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake enshrines its place in the gaming canon for generations to come. But despite its stupendous production values, the game left me feeling oddly bereft.

entry.title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
entry.summary: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

entry.title: These 10 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
entry.summary: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.

entry.title: 'We have great leverage here': DNC chair Ken Martin on Democrats' midterms sweep
entry.summary: Democrats flipped Senate seats in Republican strongholds and won control of Congress. DNC chair Ken Martin explains why he believes voters gave his party a mandate and what comes next.

entry.title: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford beats Republican incumbent for governor
entry.summary: Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.
